testCases.title: First Page Load & Bootstrap Performance
testCases.preconditions: Clean network session, no prior cache
steps: 1. Request root URL over HTTPS.
2. Inspect HTTP status and response headers.
3. Verify Frame 0 zero-flicker boot loader structure.
4. Measure network round-trip time.
testCases.expected: HTTP 200, zero-flicker boot loader present, root mount element present, load time < 1500ms.
testCases.actual: HTTP 200, response time 128ms, boot loader: Present, root mount: Present.
testCases.evidence: HTTP Status: 200, Elapsed: 128ms, Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
testCases.notes: Frame 0 bootloader guarantees instant paint before JS engine hydration.

testCases.title: Deep-Link Navigation & SPA Fallback: /explore
testCases.preconditions: SPA rewriting enabled in hosting configuration
steps: 1. Request deep-link https://paletteparadise.vercel.app/explore directly without client-side navigation.
2. Verify 200 response code and valid HTML shell.
testCases.expected: HTTP 200 with HTML root shell returned for client-side router resolution.

defects.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header on Vercel deployment
steps: 1. Send curl/fetch request to root URL.
2. Inspect response headers for Content-Security-Policy.
defects.expected: Content-Security-Policy header defined to prevent inline injection risks.
defects.actual: Header Content-Security-Policy is not sent in production HTTP headers.
defects.evidence: Headers returned: access-control-allow-origin, age, cache-control, content-disposition, content-encoding, content-type, date, etag, last-modified, server, strict-transport-security, transfer-encoding, x-vercel-cache, x-vercel-id
